# Welcome! {.unnumbered}

This is the website for “DevOps for Data Science: Lab Solutions” which provides solutions to the labs from Alex K Gold’s [DevOps for Data Science](https://do4ds.com/). A print version of this book is available as part of [Chapman & Hall’s R Series](https://www.routledge.com/Chapman--HallCRC-The-R-Series/book-series/CRCTHERSER). 

Working through the labs solutions provides a better understanding of *DevOps conventions, tools, and practices* to *work better with the IT/Admin team at your organization*.
